pages.title: Uranium Ore
pages.text: Generates underground in the overworld and drops a $(thing)Uranium Chunk$(). Smelt the chunk into an ingot, or run it through a crusher for two dust.$(br2)$(item)Deepslate Uranium Ore$() is the deepslate variant and behaves identically.

pages.title: Uranium
pages.text: The starting reactor fuel. Drop ingots into an Access Port set to Inlet and they fill the fuel rods.$(br2)$(item)Uranium Dust$() smelts into an ingot, and a $(item)Uranium Block$() stores nine of them. $(item)Raw Uranium Block$() stores nine chunks.

pages.title: Cyanite
pages.text: Reactor waste. Pull it out through an Access Port set to Outlet.$(br2)It is not garbage: a $(l:machines/cyanite_reprocessor)Cyanite Reprocessor$() turns it into blutonium. It is also a crafting ingredient for most reactor and turbine parts.

pages.title: Blutonium
pages.text: Made by reprocessing cyanite. A denser and hotter fuel than uranium, and the ingredient that separates the basic parts from the advanced ones.$(br2)Also available as dust and as a storage block.

pages.title: Graphite
pages.text: Smelt coal or charcoal to get graphite. Cheap, plentiful, and the block form is the standard reactor moderator.$(br2)Also available as dust.

pages.title: Ludicrite
pages.text: The end game material. The block is simultaneously the best moderator and the best turbine coil the mod ships.$(br2)Expensive to make, and worth it once your reactors can feed the turbines that use it.
